title: Cauliflower, Quinoa and Tofu Patties
subtitle: vegan and protein-packed
description: Juicy vegan patties made from mashed cauliflower and quinoa, with soft tofu for extra protein.

steps.text: Break the cauliflower into florets and boil in water until soft.
Drain, mash to a puree and transfer to a bowl.
Put the quinoa in a pot with 1 cup of water, bring to the boil, cover and cook for 10 minutes.
Add the cooked quinoa to the bowl with the mashed cauliflower.
Grate the tofu on a fine grater and add to the bowl.
Add the remaining ingredients and mix well.
Heat a little oil in a frying pan, shape the mixture into patties and fry until golden on both sides (start on high heat, and once one side is golden lower the heat and turn).
Drain on paper towel and serve.
